<thought>Generate a diverse list of up to 40 nitride compositions, then retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition within 0.3 eV/atom above the hull, consolidate all results into a single JSON dataset, and return the path to that dataset.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiN", "VN", "ZrN", "HfN", "CrN", "MoN", "NbN", "TaN", "WN", "AlN",
        "GaN", "InN", "Si3N4", "BN", "SiN", "GeN", "SnN", "PbN", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2",
        "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2", "Li3N", "Na3N", "K3N", "Be3N2", "Cd3N2", "Zn3N2", "Cu3N",
        "FeN", "CoN", "NiN", "PdN", "PtN", "Ag3N", "Au3N", "Bi3N2", "SbN", "AsN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "nitride_polymorphs"
}
</action_input>
